easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to untap Daring Thief.
An opponent must control a permanent that shares a type with the one you wish to exchange.
description:
Untap Daring Thief using any method. It triggers, exchanging control of a permanent an opponent controls and Altanak.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
